content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text addresses a pressed link by saying one verse phrase is immediately qualified by another verse, which is a verse-level treatment of the collision.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "\"never verse by verse\": (A) forbids resolving a pressed link by immediate qualification in one verse pair when the witnesses are a chain; (B) merely forbids treating one isolated verse as decisive while allowing local verse context.", "why": "The judge's own stated reason is immediate qualification in Luke 2:48-49, not a chain-against-chain weighing by footing."}
